items.text: In version 1.0.5. many changes have been made. Everything was based on your feedback:
New languages were added. Now Fearmonium is available on: Russian, English, German, Portuguese, Spanish, French and Japanese;
Fixed the balance in battles with bosses: no more enemies that took some players 10 minutes to kill. However now the main character also receive more damage;
Improved the impact from the attacks;
Changes affected sections that annoyed some of the players: for example, an escape from a crowd of schoolchildren is much more easier now;
Changed the behavior of some mobs;
Changed the arrangement of mobs on some levels;

Changed the way some abilities are used. For example, the Wizard now deals more damage, but since now while using an umbrella stamina doesn't restore.: Hope the game gets better.: Feel free to report any issues you find in the related thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1068360/discussions/0/3117032860239491802/
A small patch affecting a couple of rare, but very unpleasant bugs:
Disappeared the possibility of "breaking" Vincent with a very rapid improvement of abilities disappeared;

Disappeared the possibility of losing one of the three keys. If you defeated three bosses in a certain chapter of the game, but you have two keys in your inventory - do not be afraid, go to the door to stepfather's office, it will open;
Fixed a few more "joints" at inclined platforms, where the character could stuck into an invisible wall;

The ability to fly off the screen in one of the places with trees has disappeared.: Important information: [/ b]: Even minor changes can lead to unexpected bugs. A bug I know caused by updates: the likelihood of losing the file where the game settings are stored. This happens in 1 person out of 100 and is fraught with the fact that when you try to load the game, each slot will show the inscription "new game".: If you are sure that in the main menu on one of the slots you had a save, but you see the inscription "new game", to load your save, select the desired slot and simultaneously click on "1 + 2 + 3" (not on the numlok). The game should load. If something doesn't work out - feel free to write to me at redblackspade@gmail.com
Now you can choose out of four languages!
All the thanks for Portugese goes to Grégory Rodrigues Teixeira! For the German thanks goes to Martina Seemann, Steven Korkowsky and Marcel Weyers!
If you found any mistakes in these translations - please let me know!
So, friends, the moment has come for the most serious update of all that I have planned. The new version of the game has revised balance, controls and key animations.

notes.title: Take a look on the new battle system

items.text: What's new?
Added a separate stamina bar for the dash;
Increased hammer attack radius;
Increased hammer attack speed;
Dash now gives invulnerability even without a special item;
The time of invulnerability after taking damage has been extended;
The "unconscious" item increases the invulnerability time after receiving damage even more;
The character moves forward during the attack only if the key is held in the direction of movement;
Changed the way to control the wheel for selecting skills and items - now the button to the right moves the cursor clockwise, and to the left - anti-clockwise;
Scooter control should become more convenient;
Changed the ability "Audric" - now his head flies off, check it out yourself;
Significantly increased "coyote time";
The school jock, throwing cheerleaders, now throws them a little more slowly, and the cheerleaders can be destroyed;
Changed the ability "Agatha";
The wizard can now damage mobs;
Increased missile speed;
Reduced the price for improving the consolidation - (was 800, now 300 balloons);
Antidepressant is now less greedy and has dropped the prices for hints on the map by about 10 times;
Huge discounts on Vincent's services. If earlier he took 200/300/400 balloons for improving abilities, now he takes 50/75/100);
Felix fights much harder now;
Reduced the amount of HP of the final boss;
Reduced the amount of HP at the pre-final boss, but physically he became stronger;
Thyroxine now drops even more frequently.
Fixed bug with Pendelweiss on the swing;
Fire now deals damage to a huge trees;
Changed the hitbox of the big knight - now it is impossible to be killed by touching his leg;
Fixed a bug when a pumped-up cat fell off platforms;
Fixed a couple more places where the character rested against an invisible wall at the junction of the platforms;
Soap bubbles are now destroyed after damaging the character in order to avoid repeated damage;
In the place in the city where many players were disoriented due to hearts, hearts are now removed and only appear during the battle for the lighter;
Fixed a rare bug when the whispers of hylophobia did not stop after killing the boss;
Removed the possibility of accidentally losing one key when there are more than three of them in the inventory;

Any such major changes can lead to unexpected bugs. A bug I know that may be caused by updates: the likelihood of losing the file where the game settings are stored. This happens in 1 case out of 100 and is fraught with the fact that when you try to load the game, each slot will show the inscription "new game".

If you are sure that you had a save in one of the save slots, but you see the inscription "new game", to load your save you should select the desired slot and simultaneously press on "1 + 2 + 3 "(not on namlok). If something doesn't work out - feel free to write to me at redblackspade@gmail.com
Legacy branch

In case If for some reason you want to continue playing on the previous version of the game or just to take a look on how the game was before, then there is a Legacy branch for you! In order to switch to it, select Fearmonium in the list of applications in the Steam client, right-click on the title of the game, select "properties", "betas " and select legacy in the list of branches. The name of the game will change to Fearmonium .
I hope I made the game better and will definitely continue to improve it.

topNew: Added a separate stamina bar for the dash;

items.text: Second patch is here!
What has changed?
The probability of getting balloons while breaking lamps is increased;
The cost for buying a hint from Melfice has been reduced;
Increased reward for additional thyroxine for Sadness;
Fixed most of the inclined surfaces, the joints on which the character could not overcome without jumping;
Boss "Bully" can no longer move abruptly to the center of the screen after bouncing off the wall;
Girls-basketball players were sometimes letting shells pass through. Now this is fixed;
Fixed a bug when Vincent could take double payment for improving an ability;
Final Boss now cannot be provoke into an attack that cannot be dodged;
Fixed a rare half-second stuck of the character in the air in the battle with the final boss;
The ability to accidentally run into a shortcut, which confuses the order of walkthrough, has been removed;
Appearing of the log in the wrong place in the woods should now be fixed;
Several typos were fixed;
A bunch of small bug fixes, which I myself have already forgotten.
What's next?
Trading Cards will finally appear in the game soon!
Also I launched translation of the game into several additional languages.
Let me know about the bugs found in the relevant thread in the discussions and I will fix them as quickly as I can :)
First patch is here!
What was changed?
Fairies in the Forest now don't chase the character for the whole eternity - now it's possible to run away from them - thanks for this idea to steam user Miles Hikari.
Now it's possible to zoom the map - thanks for this idea to Adze who made a wonderful review of the game on YouTube.
Fixed stucking in some inclined surfaces in the Forest and School area - thanks to users Cpt.ButtHurt.
Fixed a situation when player was able to stuck after picking up the Noradrenaline - thanks to steam user Carnagik.
Fixed possibility to "stand on" some walls - thanks to steam user happygiggi.
Fixed a rare case when sellers take double cost for items - thanks to steam user suharki.
"Bright Memory"'s health points were lowered - thanks to all the streamers who suffered from this boss on my eyes.
In rare cases "Vampirism" didn't appear in the hidden wall - now it does appear always - thanks to steam user SHiSH.
Monsters drop a little bit more balloons right now.
Several really minor issues.
But there is also a bad news in here.

Linux players faced some troubles with playing the game so I temporarily "hide" linux support from the store page. Those who already bought the game will still receive all the updates. But before I figure out how to make Fearmonium run on all the varieties of Linux OS - I don't promise the game will work fine.
